reason: Docker base image bumps (RC to GA .NET 10, and Dockerfile-CI jumping from 8.0 to 10.0) only affect container build/runtime images, not application source code, but the CI image's major version jump could surface subtle runtime/behavioral differences in CI-built containers worth a quick review.
